module_summary: 8-bit logical right barrel shifter built from three cascaded stages of eight 2:1 muxes shifting by 4, 2 and 1 under ctrl bits, zero-filling vacated bits.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: 8-bit data to be shifted, feeds the 4-bit shift stage muxes.

anchors.name: ctrl
anchors.why: Shift amount; each bit selects one mux stage (4, 2, 1).

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Final shifted result from the 1-bit shift stage.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Intermediate result after optional 4-bit right shift.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Intermediate result after optional 2-bit right shift.

groups.name: Shift-by-4 stage
groups.description: Eight muxes controlled by ctrl[2] producing x.

groups.name: Shift-by-2 stage
groups.description: Eight muxes controlled by ctrl[1] producing y.

groups.name: Shift-by-1 stage
groups.description: Eight muxes controlled by ctrl[0] producing out.

groups.name: Shift control
groups.description: Input data and per-stage shift select bits.
